note: Forge's debugger: launch configurations from .forge/launch.json (forge.debug.launchConfigurations, a subset), a session with lldb-dap or debugpy through the dap service the host granted (Debug.cpp), breakpoints in the editor's gutter, the call stack, variables, watches and the debug console. Every request goes through debugRequest, which names the service by state.debug.type and runs the answer action with `body` and `context`; the adapter's events go to debugEvent. The actions that take the adapter's messages as events (debugApplySession, debugApplyEvent, debugApplyResponse) let a scenario or an agent drive the views without an adapter. What an adapter sends is bounded in the dap service; here the console keeps 2000 lines, the history 100 entries and the variables 5000 rows. The views are in debugViews.json.

computed.debugMarks: {{concat(map(state.debug.breakpoints, {path: it.path, mark: {line: it.line - 1, kind: 'gutter', text: !it.enabled ? '○' : !empty(it.logMessage) ? '◆' : '●', color: !it.enabled || (state.debug.status != 'inactive' && !it.verified) ? '#848484' : '#e51400'}}), state.debug.status == 'stopped' && state.debug.current.line > 0 ? [{path: state.debug.current.path, mark: {line: state.debug.current.line - 1, kind: 'background', color: '#ffcc0040'}}] : [], state.debug.status == 'stopped' && !empty(state.debug.exception) && state.debug.current.line > 0 ? [{path: state.debug.current.path, mark: {line: state.debug.current.line - 1, kind: 'inline', color: '#f85149', text: state.debug.exception}}] : [], state.debug.status == 'stopped' && !empty(state.debug.hover.value) ? [{path: state.debug.hover.path, mark: {line: state.debug.hover.line, kind: 'inline', color: '#3794ff', text: state.debug.hover.word + ' = ' + state.debug.hover.value}}] : [])}}
computed.debugStackRows: {{concat(map(slice(state.debug.threads, 0, indexOf(map(state.debug.threads, it.id), state.debug.threadId) + 1), {id: 't:' + it.id, label: it.name + (it.id == state.debug.threadId && state.debug.status == 'stopped' ? '  paused on ' + state.debug.reason : ''), icon: 'list-tree'}), map(state.debug.frames, {id: 'f:' + it.id, label: '    ' + it.name + '  ' + (empty(it.path) ? 'unknown source' : reverse(split(it.path, '/'))[0]) + ':' + it.line, icon: it.id == state.debug.frameId ? 'arrow-right' : '', iconColor: it.inside ? '#e5c07b' : '#848484'}), map(slice(state.debug.threads, indexOf(map(state.debug.threads, it.id), state.debug.threadId) + 1), {id: 't:' + it.id, label: it.name, icon: 'list-tree'}))}}
computed.debugVariableRows: {{map(state.debug.variables, {id: it.path, label: pad('', it.depth * 2) + (it.kind == 'more' ? '  … ' + it.value : (it.ref > 0 ? (it.expanded ? '▾ ' : '▸ ') : '  ') + it.name + (it.kind == 'scope' ? '' : ' = ' + it.value))})}}
computed.debugWatchRows: {{map(state.debug.watches, {id: it.id, label: it.expression + ' = ' + (empty(it.error) ? (state.debug.status == 'stopped' ? it.value : 'not available') : it.error), icon: 'eye', iconColor: empty(it.error) ? '#848484' : '#f85149'})}}
computed.debugBreakpointRows: {{map(state.debug.breakpoints, {id: it.id, label: reverse(split(it.path, '/'))[0] + ':' + it.line + (empty(it.condition) ? '' : '  if ' + it.condition) + (empty(it.hitCondition) ? '' : '  hits ' + it.hitCondition) + (empty(it.logMessage) ? '' : '  log ' + it.logMessage) + (state.debug.status != 'inactive' && !it.verified && !empty(it.message) ? '  (' + it.message + ')' : ''), icon: !it.enabled ? 'circle-off' : !empty(it.logMessage) ? 'diamond' : 'circle', iconColor: !it.enabled || (state.debug.status != 'inactive' && !it.verified) ? '#848484' : '#e51400'})}}
computed.debugConsoleRows: {{map(state.debug.console, {id: it.id, label: it.text, icon: it.kind == 'input' ? 'chevron-right' : it.kind == 'error' || it.kind == 'stderr' ? 'circle-x' : '', iconColor: it.kind == 'input' ? '#3794ff' : '#f85149'})}}

with.message: No launch configuration: add one of type lldb or python to the open folder's .forge/launch.json, then reload.

with.arguments: {{ {clientID: 'forge', clientName: 'Forge', adapterID: state.debug.type == 'python' ? 'debugpy' : 'lldb-dap', locale: 'en', linesStartAt1: true, columnsStartAt1: true, pathFormat: 'path', supportsVariableType: true, supportsVariablePaging: true, supportsRunInTerminalRequest: true} }}

debugApplyFilters.to: {{map(slice(filters, 0, 20), {filter: text(it.filter), label: text(it.label ?? it.filter), enabled: state.debug.filterChoices[text(it.filter)] ?? it.default ?? false})}}

with.context: {{ {path: path, ids: map(filter(state.debug.breakpoints, it.path == path && it.enabled), it.id)} }}
with.arguments: {{ {source: {path: path}, breakpoints: map(filter(state.debug.breakpoints, it.path == path && it.enabled), merge({line: it.line}, empty(it.condition) ? {} : {condition: it.condition}, empty(it.hitCondition) ? {} : {hitCondition: it.hitCondition}, empty(it.logMessage) ? {} : {logMessage: it.logMessage})), sourceModified: false} }}

debugOnSetBreakpoints.to: {{map(state.debug.breakpoints, contains(context.ids, it.id) ? merge(it, {verified: body.breakpoints[indexOf(context.ids, it.id)].verified ?? false, message: text(body.breakpoints[indexOf(context.ids, it.id)].message ?? ''), adapterId: body.breakpoints[indexOf(context.ids, it.id)].id ?? null}) : it)}}

then.to: {{map(state.debug.breakpoints, it.adapterId != null && it.adapterId == message.body.breakpoint.id ? merge(it, {verified: message.body.breakpoint.verified ?? it.verified, message: text(message.body.breakpoint.message ?? '')}) : it)}}

debugPrintLines.to: {{slice(concat(state.debug.console, map(slice(lines, 0, length(lines) - (empty(lines[length(lines) - 1]) ? 1 : 0)), {id: 'c' + (state.debug.consoleNext + index), text: it, kind: kind})), -2000)}}

then.to: {{map(body.stackFrames ?? [], {id: it.id, name: text(it.name ?? ''), line: it.line ?? 0, path: text(it.source.path ?? it.source.name ?? ''), relative: text(it.source.relative ?? ''), inside: it.source.inside ?? false, reference: it.source.sourceReference ?? 0})}}

debugSelectFrame.to: {{ {path: frame.inside ? frame.relative : 'debug-source:' + (empty(frame.path) ? 'ref:' + frame.reference : frame.path), line: frame.line, inside: frame.inside} }}

then.to: {{map(slice(body.scopes ?? [], 0, 20), {path: 's' + index, depth: 0, name: text(it.name ?? ''), value: '', ref: it.variablesReference ?? 0, indexed: it.indexedVariables ?? 0, expanded: false, kind: 'scope', expensive: it.expensive ?? false})}}
{{map(filter(state.debug.variables, slice(it.path, 0, length(row.path) + 1) != row.path + '/'), it.path == row.path ? merge(it, {expanded: false}) : it)}}

with.arguments: {{merge({variablesReference: ref}, indexed > 0 ? {filter: 'indexed', start: start, count: min(100, indexed - start)} : {})}}
with.context: {{ {parent: parent, ref: ref, depth: depth, start: start, indexed: indexed, replace: replace, frameId: state.debug.frameId} }}

debugOnVariables.if: {{context.frameId == state.debug.frameId && indexOf(map(state.debug.variables, it.path), empty(context.replace) ? context.parent : context.replace) >= 0}}

with.rows: {{concat(map(slice(body.variables ?? [], 0, max(0, 5000 - length(state.debug.variables))), {path: context.parent + '/' + (context.start + index), depth: context.depth, name: text(it.name ?? ''), value: text(it.value ?? ''), type: text(it.type ?? ''), ref: it.variablesReference ?? 0, indexed: it.indexedVariables ?? 0, expanded: false, kind: 'variable', container: context.ref}), context.indexed > 0 && context.start + 100 < context.indexed ? [{path: context.parent + '/more' + (context.start + 100), depth: context.depth, name: '', value: text(context.indexed - context.start - 100) + ' more', ref: context.ref, indexed: context.indexed, expanded: false, kind: 'more', parent: context.parent, start: context.start + 100}] : [])}}

then.to: {{ {open: true, path: row.path, name: row.name, value: row.value} }}

with.message: Select a variable: the debugger can set the value of variables only.

with.arguments: {{ {variablesReference: find(state.debug.variables, it.path == state.debug.setValue.path).container, name: state.debug.setValue.name, value: state.debug.setValue.value} }}

debugOnSetVariable.to: {{map(state.debug.variables, it.path == context.path ? merge(it, {value: text(body.value ?? it.value), type: text(body.type ?? it.type)}) : it)}}

debugOnWatch.to: {{map(state.debug.watches, it.id == context.id ? merge(it, {value: text(body.result ?? ''), error: ''}) : it)}}

debugOnWatchError.to: {{map(state.debug.watches, it.id == context.id ? merge(it, {value: '', error: message}) : it)}}

with.text: Start a debug session to evaluate expressions.

with.arguments: {{merge({text: state.debug.input, column: length(state.debug.input) + 1}, state.debug.frameId == null ? {} : {frameId: state.debug.frameId})}}

{{merge({open: true, id: id}, find(state.debug.breakpoints, it.id == id) ?? {})}}

debugApplyBreakpoint.to: {{map(state.debug.breakpoints, it.path == event.path && it.line == event.line ? merge(it, {condition: event.condition ?? '', hitCondition: event.hitCondition ?? '', logMessage: event.logMessage ?? ''}) : it)}}
